title: Judiciary Amendment (Commonwealth Model Litigant Obligations) Bill 2017
short_title: Judiciary Amendment (Commonwealth Model Litigant Obligations) Bill 2017

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would make the Commonwealth's model litigant rules legally enforceable.

It would require the Attorney-General to set those rules, let the Commonwealth Ombudsman investigate complaints about breaches, and allow courts to pause cases or make other orders if a breach is found.
The bill would start the day after it receives royal assent.
changes: Creates enforceable model litigant obligations for Commonwealth litigants.
Establishes a complaint process through the Commonwealth Ombudsman.
Gives courts power to stay proceedings or make other orders for contraventions.
summary.affected: Commonwealth litigants, including government agencies and their legal representatives.
